in_marathi.name: Hamanta

in_marathi.long_meaning: Hamanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hamanta is a name of the Goddess of Winter in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ham', which means 'cold' or 'winter'. Hamanta is often depicted as a goddess of fertility, as she is believed to bring the cold winter rains that nourish the earth and help crops grow.
